methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Safari led browsers (mobile) in Australia at 48.72% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome ranked second at 43.29%, followed by Samsung Internet at 5.76%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Safari leads at 48.72% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/australia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Safari (48.72%), Chrome (43.29%), Samsung Internet (5.76%) in October 2026.
